faq.title: Steal an Egg FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about the current Roblox experience and this independent wiki.

items.question: What is Steal an Egg?
items.answer: Steal an Egg is a Roblox collection game where players steal guarded eggs, escape to their base, hatch pets that earn money, upgrade their base, and train speed to reach harder biomes.

items.question: Are there working Steal an Egg codes?
items.answer: No verified working codes or confirmed redemption field were found as of August 26, 2026.

items.question: How many biomes and pets are there?
items.answer: Recent community sources disagree because the game is updating quickly. This wiki treats the in-game Index as the final authority and timestamps every tracked count.

items.question: Is this the official Steal an Egg wiki?
items.answer: No. This is an independent fan-made English resource. Roblox and the game developer remain the official sources for support, purchases, moderation, and account issues.

items.question: Is there a real Steal an Egg pet tier list?
items.answer: There is no reliable universal tier list while the game changes quickly. This wiki provides a transparent personal-ranking framework based on live income, route time, risk, and evidence.

closingCta.title: Use Live Values, Not Stale Guesswork
closingCta.description: Bookmark the wiki, compare every update-sensitive claim with its check date, and use the calculators with numbers from your own base.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn who maintains Steal an Egg Wiki, how evidence and corrections are reviewed, and why this fan site is independent of Roblox and the developer.
intro: {siteName} is an independent, fan-made reference for {gameName} on Roblox. We publish English guides, reference pages, and calculators to help players understand the game and check update-sensitive information.

We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to Roblox Corporation, the game developer, or any official game community. For the current experience and its developer information, visit the official Roblox game page.

sections.heading: What We Cover
items: Egg, pet, mutation, and biome references
Progression and route guides for new and returning players
Calculators that use values supplied by the player
Source labels, update notes, and a public correction log

sections.heading: Who Maintains the Wiki
paragraphs: The site's maintainers publish under the editorial name Steal an Egg Wiki Editors. This is a fan project, and that name does not represent an official Roblox or game-development team. The public repository provides the site's source and change history. Reading guides and using calculators require no site account.

sections.heading: Sources, Corrections, and Community Contributions
paragraphs: Official statements, community observations, and calculated estimates are labeled separately. Conflicting sources and missing evidence stay visible. Check the source and evidence policy and data corrections log for details.

Readers can propose changes through external GitHub issues or pull requests. A maintainer must review the evidence, wording, links, and rights to contributed material before it is incorporated into a published page. Submission does not publish a comment or article on this website. On-site comments and public uploads are currently disabled. Unsupported claims, spam, harassment, private information, and infringing material should not be included in contributions.
Use the contact page to report a correction or rights concern. We do not promise a fixed review time.

sections.heading: Game Support and Ownership
paragraphs: Roblox Corporation and the game developer handle their own accounts, purchases, moderation, and support. This wiki cannot grant rewards, restore accounts, reverse bans, or process refunds.

Roblox is a trademark of Roblox Corporation. Game names, logos, characters, and other third-party material belong to their respective owners. See the copyright page for attribution, licensing, and reporting information.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: How Steal an Egg Wiki handles Cloudflare analytics, browser storage, YouTube requests, GitHub submissions, advertising choices, and privacy questions.
intro: This policy explains information handling on {siteName}, an independent fan website. It covers this website; external services have their own policies. For questions, use the contact route below.

Current services: Cloudflare hosts this site and Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled. Google Analytics, Google AdSense advertising, and embedded GitHub comments (giscus) are currently disabled. We provide no site account, checkout, newsletter signup, or public upload form. Pages can include YouTube thumbnails and videos as explained below.

sections.heading: Hosting and Traffic Measurement
paragraphs: Your browser sends network requests to load our pages. Cloudflare processes request information, which can include your IP address, traffic-routing information, and system configuration, to deliver and protect its services. This is separate from the aggregate analytics described below. See Cloudflare's Privacy Policy.

Cloudflare Web Analytics measures page views and page performance. Reports can be grouped by page, referring site, browser, operating system, device type, and country. We use these reports to understand traffic and improve pages. Cloudflare describes Web Analytics as not using cookies or localStorage to identify visitors and not fingerprinting individuals. Read its analytics privacy FAQ and reported dimensions.

sections.heading: Browser Storage, Search, and Calculators
paragraphs: The site uses browser localStorage to remember the theme you select. The article helpfulness buttons store only that you have answered for that page, so the prompt is not repeated; the current feature does not send your answer to a server. These preferences stay in that browser until cleared by you or your browser.

If the site's optional consent notice is displayed, it stores your accepted or declined choice in localStorage. Advertising and Google Analytics are currently off, so the notice is not needed for those services in this version. A stored choice from an earlier visit may remain until you clear site data.

Calculator inputs and results are processed in your browser; the calculators do not submit them to the wiki or connect to your Roblox account. Site search uses downloaded search-index files in your browser. Neither tool requires your real name, email, Roblox password, or payment details. Ordinary page and file requests still reach our hosting provider.

sections.heading: YouTube Thumbnails and Video Playback
paragraphs: A page with a video may request a thumbnail from i.ytimg.com before you press play. That request exposes network information such as your IP address and browser headers to Google's service. Pressing play loads an embedded player from youtube-nocookie.com, which contacts YouTube and processes playback information under Google's policies. Using the privacy-enhanced player does not mean that no data is transmitted.

You can read the surrounding article without playing a video. Your browser's content controls can block external images or media requests. Following a YouTube link opens that external service. Learn how Google uses information from sites that use its services and read the Google Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Contact, Corrections, and GitHub
paragraphs: Our contact page links to an external public GitHub issue tracker. If you submit an issue or pull request, your GitHub profile, message, attachments, and subsequent discussion may be publicly visible, indexed, or copied. The maintainers can read that information to investigate and respond; accepted corrections may become part of the website and repository history.

Do not include passwords, account tokens, payment information, home addresses, children's personal information, or other sensitive data in a public report. Use a minimal page URL and a description of the problem. If you need a private channel, request one without posting the private details; no private contact form is currently provided by this site. GitHub controls its account data and platform retention under the GitHub General Privacy Statement.

sections.heading: Advertising Cookies and Future Advertising
paragraphs: We do not currently load Google AdSense ads. If advertising is enabled later, this policy and the on-site choices must be updated to identify the active services before they are introduced.

When Google advertising is used, third-party vendors, including Google, may use cookies, web beacons, IP addresses, or device identifiers to deliver and measure ads. Google and its partners can use advertising cookies to personalize ads based on earlier visits to this website and other websites. Other participating ad vendors or networks may also use their own cookies; their identities and policy links must be disclosed when enabled.

You can manage or opt out of Google's personalized advertising in Google Ads Settings, and review participating vendors' choices at aboutads.info. These choices concern ad personalization; they do not necessarily stop all ads or all service requests. Browser cookie controls provide additional choices. See Google's advertising technology policy.

Before introducing advertising that requires consent, we must provide the applicable consent controls and a way to revisit or withdraw choices. Personalized Google ads for visitors in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland require a Google-certified consent management platform integrated with the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework. The site's basic optional-services banner is not such a certified platform and is not a substitute for it. See Google's consent requirements.

sections.heading: Your Choices and Privacy Requests
items: Clear this website's cookies and site data in your browser to remove locally saved preferences. This also resets the theme, helpfulness marker, and any saved consent choice. Clearing this site's storage does not delete information held by external services.

Use your browser's cookie, tracking-protection, script, and media controls to limit optional requests. Reading static articles does not require accepting advertising; some interactive features need JavaScript.
Review the controls offered by Google, GitHub, and Cloudflare in the policies linked above for information they process.

For information the wiki maintainers control, use the contact page to ask about access, correction, or deletion. Describe the request without exposing personal details publicly. Available rights depend on your location and the information involved. We may need a way to verify a request before acting on it.

sections.heading: Children and Personal Information
paragraphs: This wiki covers a Roblox game and may be read by younger players. Reading and using the calculators require no age, real name, or account information. Children should not post personal information in external reports or follow account-verification requests from strangers; a parent or guardian can help with a report.

If you believe a child has shared personal information in content the maintainers control, use the contact page to flag the relevant location without repeating the information. Requests about a third-party account or service should also be directed to that provider.

sections.heading: Retention, External Services, and Policy Changes
paragraphs: Browser preferences remain locally until cleared. External services have their own retention and processing arrangements, described in their policies; this site does not set a universal deletion period for their records. Public issues, contributions, and repository history may persist even after a page is changed, and copies held by others may remain.
We will update this page when the site's services or handling of information change. The date above identifies the latest policy revision.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Report factual corrections, broken links, accessibility issues, privacy questions, or copyright concerns to the independent Steal an Egg Wiki maintainers.
intro: Use the public GitHub issue tracker to contact the {siteName} maintainers about this website. This is an external service and may require a GitHub account.

Reports are public. Do not post passwords, payment details, account tokens, home addresses, or other private information. If your request needs private details, ask for a private contact method without including them in the issue. We currently do not publish a private email address or provide a private contact form.

sections.heading: What to Include in a Correction
items: The URL of the affected wiki page and the sentence, value, or link that needs attention
The proposed correction, its source, and the date or game version you checked
A relevant screenshot with usernames and other personal information removed, if needed

sections.heading: How Reports Are Reviewed
paragraphs: A maintainer reviews proposed evidence, accuracy, links, and rights before adding a contribution to the website. GitHub issues and pull requests do not automatically become site content. On-site comments and public uploads are disabled. We may ask for supporting evidence, correct or remove a claim, or decline unsupported and unsuitable submissions. There is no guaranteed review or response time.
Read the source policy and check the corrections log before submitting a duplicate report.

sections.heading: Copyright and Privacy Questions
paragraphs: For a copyright concern, identify the work, the affected wiki URL, and your relationship to the rights holder. Do not publish identity documents or private legal contact information. See the copyright page for the review process and the privacy policy for how public submissions are handled.

sections.heading: Game and Account Support
paragraphs: We are independent of Roblox Corporation and the game developer. We cannot change accounts, purchases, rewards, bans, or moderation decisions. Use the official Roblox game page and the support channels provided by Roblox or the developer for those matters.
